findings.documented: Tokens valid for 24h. Explicitly states 'There is no refresh flow.'
findings.actual: Tokens expire quickly. API requires calling POST /auth/refresh with a refresh_token.
findings.how_found: Listings API returned 401 detailing the exact POST /auth/refresh endpoint.
findings.impact: Sessions drop unexpectedly; forces developers to implement an undocumented token refresh interceptor.
